name: as500
description: AS500 Terminal System - AS/400 inspired time tracking

scripts.build:server: cd server && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix client run tsc -- --noEmit
